name: Drought
value: Sudan harvest near record-poor; no famine call
summary: El Niño drought leaves Sudan's harvests near record-poor and raises famine risk; no drought-driven famine declared
state: The International Rescue Committee warned on 13 Oct that war and El Niño-driven drought have depleted food stocks in Sudan, pushing Darfur and Kordofan towards famine, with harvests near record-poor (IRC; AllAfrica). El Niño is weighing on crops across several regions (Wikifarmer). Searches on 26 Nov found no drought-driven famine declaration and no major exporter's harvest failure, so Watch holds.
for_you: Food aid needs in East Africa are rising; UN agencies' appeals set out where help is needed.
rubric_hit: Severe drought in a major crop region = Watch; no drought-driven famine or exporter harvest failure

sources.title: International Rescue Committee — War and El Niño-driven drought deplete food stocks, pushing Sudan further towards famine
AllAfrica — Sudan: Drought and war push Darfur and Kordofan towards famine
Wikifarmer — El Niño 2026: crops by region

why: Drought slowly destroys harvests, hydropower and river shipping, and drives famine and migration.
drivers: Rainfall deficits, heat, ENSO, groundwater depletion.

rubric.alert: Drought driving famine conditions, a major exporter's harvest failure, or monsoon failure across a major breadbasket.
rubric.watch: Severe drought in a major crop region, a major river at record low, or a monsoon running more than 20% below normal.
rubric.normal: No major breadbasket in severe drought.
